metricDefinitions.name: Average Residual Risk Score
metricDefinitions.description: Tenant-wide average residual risk score across active risks.

metricDefinitions.name: Escalated Risks Count
metricDefinitions.description: Count of risks currently in ESCALATED status.

metricDefinitions.name: Control Operating Effectiveness Rate
metricDefinitions.description: Percentage of active controls rated EFFECTIVE on latest operating test.

metricDefinitions.name: Open Control Exceptions
metricDefinitions.description: Count of control exceptions not yet closed or risk-accepted.

metricDefinitions.name: Obligation Compliance Rate
metricDefinitions.description: Percentage of active obligations rated COMPLIANT.

metricDefinitions.name: Regulatory Changes In Flight
metricDefinitions.description: Count of regulatory changes not yet closed.

metricDefinitions.name: Average Audit Non-Compliance Rate
metricDefinitions.description: Average non-compliance rate across finalized engagements.

metricDefinitions.name: Open High/Critical Audit Findings
metricDefinitions.description: Count of open findings rated HIGH or CRITICAL.

metricDefinitions.name: Critical Security Findings Open
metricDefinitions.description: Count of open security findings rated CRITICAL.

metricDefinitions.name: Patch SLA Compliance Rate
metricDefinitions.description: Percentage of critical/high vulnerabilities remediated within the 30-day SLA.

metricDefinitions.name: Policy Acknowledgement Rate
metricDefinitions.description: Average acknowledgement completion rate across active campaigns.

metricDefinitions.name: Open Incidents (Rolling 90 Days)
metricDefinitions.description: Count of incidents reported in the last 90 days not yet closed.

metricDefinitions.name: CAPA On-Time Completion Rate
metricDefinitions.description: Percentage of CAPA action items completed by their due date.

metricDefinitions.name: Critical Vendor Concentration
metricDefinitions.description: Percentage of active vendors classified as CRITICAL criticality.

metricDefinitions.name: Vendor SLA Breach Rate
metricDefinitions.description: Percentage of monitored vendor SLAs currently in AMBER or RED band.

metricDefinitions.name: Critical Service RTO Attainment Rate
metricDefinitions.description: Percentage of continuity exercises in the last 12 months meeting target RTO.

metricDefinitions.name: Enterprise GRC Composite Health Index
metricDefinitions.description: Weighted composite of risk, control, compliance and audit posture (derived metric).

metricDefinitions.name: Pending Approvals Aging (Avg Days)
metricDefinitions.description: Average age in days of pending maker-checker approvals across all modules.
